assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Jasmin and James 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：他们是谁？是情侣吗？国籍是什么？
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Jasmin and James 排名第 20 名，历史累计观看量约为 76B（760 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Jasmin and James 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: Jasmin and James YouTube Channel

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UC5OVPGQqCUm0CCyVzELGITQ
  • Handle: @JasminandJames
  • Canonical URLs: https://www.youtube.com/@JasminandJames ; https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5OVPGQqCUm0CCyVzELGITQ
    Sources: YouTube search results [1], Social Blade [2]
  1. OPERATORS / CREATORS
  • Jasmin Arndt: German, born November 11, 2002, in Radolfzell am Bodensee, Germany. Professional dancer since age 2.
  • James Ewens: Australian, born in Canberra, Australia. Professional dancer/ballet student.
  • They are a real-life romantic couple (boyfriend/girlfriend, together since ~August 2018). Met while studying ballet/dance at university in Germany; James moved to Germany in 2020 to study contemporary dance.
  • Described as an 'Australian couple' because they operate from Australia after relocating in 2022.
    Sources: Beacons bio page [3]; FamousBirthdays James Ewens [4]; edigitalagency.com.au [5]
  1. CHANNEL CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Channel created: September 12, 2021 (confirmed across Social Blade, VIDIQ, youtubers.me).
  • Earliest still-public upload: UNRESOLVED. The channel launched with short-form dance content in late 2021; with ~25K total uploads, many early Shorts have likely been deleted. The earliest identifiable long-form video is 'OUR FIRST VLOG! We Left Germany! Finally Moving to Australia!!!' uploaded July 9, 2022. Some early Shorts like 'THIS WASN'T EASY TO FILM' and 'SUBSCRIBE FOR 7 YEARS OF GOOD LUCK!' remain visible but exact upload dates could not be confirmed. Unable to access YouTube's 'oldest' sorted view directly due to CAPTCHA restrictions.
    Sources: Social Blade [2]; us.youtubers.me [6]; YouTube video page [7]
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Current residence: Queensland, Australia — Sunshine Coast hinterland (Landsborough area). Purchased a $6.4M property there in 2026.
  • Moved from Germany to Australia in 2022 to pursue creator careers full-time.
  • YouTube displays country as Australia (per Wikipedia's most-viewed channels list).
  • NOTE: Tubefilter flags the channel with a German flag in its charts because Jasmin hails from Germany, even though the couple is 'based Down Under.' This reflects Jasmin's nationality rather than operating location.
    Sources: Wikipedia [8]; Tubefilter [9]; news.com.au [10]; Instagram posts [11]
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: English (per Wikipedia classification).
  • Secondary: German — the couple produces occasional German-language shorts and skits (e.g., 'Only Germans will know!' series, German rhyme challenges).
    Sources: Wikipedia [8]; Facebook posts [12]
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Wikipedia: 'Entertainment'
  • CreatorDB: 'Comedy & Entertainment' niche
  • FamousBirthdays: 'Couples' genre
  • Content mix: choreographed dance routines (partner dances, viral TikTok/K-pop/Afrobeats covers), comedy sketches, couple pranks/challenges, reaction-style shorts, occasional travel/lifestyle vlogs.
    Sources: Wikipedia [8]; CreatorDB [13]; FamousBirthdays [14]
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Extremely high-volume daily Shorts strategy: approximately 32 videos/day on the main channel (most under 20 seconds), and ~37 videos/day on the secondary 'More Jasmin and James' channel.
  • Core loop: create dance/reaction content → upload as Shorts → repurpose successful clips into 'behind the scenes' extended versions.
  • Upload defaults to 15–50 shorts per day per community reports; Social Blade tracks 52 videos/day average on main channel.
  • Multi-channel network: main channel (@jasminandjames, 42.2M subs, 25K videos); 'More Jasmin and James' (5.3M subs, created Aug 4, 2024); formerly co-ran 'Double Date' with Cadel & Mia (30.5M subs, now inactive as of mid-2026); currently co-runs 'Double Trouble Squad' with US duo Rylen & Chloe.
    Sources: Themeasure/Tubular Labs [15]; Social Blade [2]; Social Blade [16]; Tubefilter [9]; CreatorDB [17]
  1. REPRESENTATIVE SERIES
  • Dance trend/reaction Shorts (viral TikTok dances adapted; e.g., Wednesday dance, Harry Potter dance, Soda Pop K-pop cover)
  • Couple challenge/prank Shorts ('Is the arrow BROKEN?', 'Who will win the race?', 'Slap Me on The Wrist')
  • 'Jasmin and James around the world | Vlogs' (playlist, 12 videos)
  • 'Jasmin and James in Japan | Vlogs' (playlist)
  • 'COMPILATIONS' (playlist)
  • Behind-the-scenes / extended versions labeled 'BTS' of popular clips
  • Long-form vlogs: house tours, moving vlogs, travel diaries
    Sources: YouTube channel page [1]; YouTube playlists [18]; FamousBirthdays [14]

VIEW COUNT NOTE: The orchestrator's Communitrics snapshot of ~76B lifetime views as of Sept 2, 2026 aligns with Social Blade tracking ~77.27B as of Sept 17, 2026. Wikipedia (June 2026) recorded 68.3B; Tubefilter (July 2026) recorded 73.5B — these reflect earlier snapshots.
